sandbachFocus: Sandbach United delivered a devastating display in the Edward Case Cup second round, destroying New Mills 7-1 away at Church Lane on Saturday 14 November. Kyle Foley was in scintillating form with a hat-trick, while Alfie Carmichael marked his debut with a goal, and Mason Wilson also scored in a commanding performance that saw The Bach progress to the quarter-finals where they'll face Alsager away on 30 January. This emphatic cup victory continued their strong recent league form, as they remain top of the table with 34 points from 16 games.
divisionWide: Telford Town recorded their first win under new management, beating Cheadle Heath Nomads 2-0 at home on 14 November thanks to goals from Tatenda Chirata and Logan Whittaker. Market Drayton Town also secured a narrow 1-0 victory at Foley Meir, with Jack Rowe scoring early to extend their unbeaten run. In a thrilling cup tie, Alsager Town knocked out AFC Bridgnorth 2-1 in the Edward Case Cup second round, with Barnett and Latter scoring. Allscott Heath produced a derby performance to beat Dawley Town 3-1, with Eden Sears bagging two goals in a strong second-half display. Bilston Town came from behind to edge out Eccleshall 3-2 in a dramatic finish, scoring twice in the final five minutes. Shawbury United impressively defeated AFC Bridgnorth 3-1 in a league match on 17 November. Stafford Town won 4-2 away at Darlaston Town in the Walsall Senior Cup, showing attacking prowess with Pat Mazurkiewicz and Lynch among the scorers. Brereton Social returned to winning ways with a 2-1 victory over Crewe, while the New Mills v Crewe league fixture scheduled for 17 November was postponed due to a waterlogged pitch.
